relations.subject: Wilhelm Halbfass
relations.evidence: He was a professor in the departments of Asian and Middle Eastern Studies and South Asia Regional Studies at the University of Pennsylvania from 1982 until his death in 2000.

relations.subject: Ludo Rocher
